paper_anchor: arXiv:2511.17864v3, Theorem 2 and Algorithm 1, Sections 3.2-3.3, labels thm:multilayer and alg:multilayer
statement: Applying the single-block construction sequentially across all L Gemma-style blocks reproduces the full-context network output for the tested token.
assumptions: Theorem 1 assumptions hold at every patched layer.
Each layer patch is recomputed from that layer's actual reduced-path input.
The target is one token/history; the patches are not claimed to be reusable globally.
verdict_rule: VERIFIED only if all 26 layer contracts and the final-logit contract pass; otherwise BLOCKED unless an assumption-satisfying counterexample contradicts the exact theorem.
